other.content:
Recto: Not signed. Not dated. Verso: Signed on backing in black ink: "Georgia O'Keeffe/1977-" 
On white label: "Georgia O'Keeffe/Abiquiu, New Mexico/Title-FROM A DAY WITH JUAN NO II/Year 1977 Size 48 x 36/Medium and base: Oil on canvas/ photograph: Malcolm Varon Transparency" On backing in wax pencil: "Q./9/8/60" 
(Source: MoMA, 2025)

cr_data.provenance:
1977 - 1986, Georgia O'Keeffe, Abiquiú, New Mexico. 
1986 - 1987, Estate of the artist, Abiquiú, New Mexico. 
1987, The Museum of Modern Art, New York, acquired as bequest from the Estate of the artist. 
(Source: MoMA, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. Backing inscription 2 indicates preparatory work. Part of a series: see cat. nos. 1619–25, 1627–31. Painted with assistance of Belarmino Lopez. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication dates this work as 1976/1977, MoMA dates it as 1977.

titles.notes: Source of title: Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977.

credit_line: The Museum of Modern Art, New York. Georgia O'Keeffe Bequest
description: A wide band of white paint extends from the bottom to the top of the composition, narrowing as it rises. Flanking this band are two narrow slivers of blue.
